义项: 名词 为支持某一主张而摆出的一整套理由与证据（a strong case that… 支持…的有力论据；make the case that… 论证、主张…）；SAT 阅读正确选项里的高频抽象义
名词 as is / was the case（…的情况也是如此）、in this case（在这种情况下）、in most cases（多数情况下）、in any case（无论如何）
名词 in each case（在每一个案例中）、case study（个案研究）；法律语境另指「诉讼案件」
搭配说明: make the case that… / as is the case / in each case — 高频固定搭配：义项随搭配在「论点 / 情形 / 案例」之间切换，不可一律译成「案例」
易误读警示: 易误读警示 — 绝大多数学生把 a strong case 读成「一个有力的案例」，但此处 case ≈ argument / evidence，义为「论据、理由」，误读会把整个正确选项理解反。词形极常见，但这一抽象书面义属高阶用法，正是收词理由。

例句.英文: Support can be found for a strong case that either Hamilton or Madison was the sole author of "The Senate."
例句.中文: 无论主张《参议院》的唯一作者是汉密尔顿还是麦迪逊，都能找到支持这一论点的有力论据。——正是双方各有强证据、彼此矛盾，才使作者归属难以定案。

例句.英文: Economists have long observed that firms in related industries tend to cluster in the same area, as is the case in Leeds, UK, where many thread and yarn spinning firms as well as textile weaving firms are located.
例句.中文: 经济学家早就注意到，相关行业的企业往往聚集在同一地区——英国利兹就是如此：许多纱线纺织企业与织物织造企业都设在当地。

义项: 名词 （哲学 / 社会学核心义）自主行动、作出选择并影响结果的能力；真题常与 constrain / give / deny 搭配
名词 政府部门或代理机构（Environmental Protection Agency）；SAT 常以此常见义作干扰项
名词 by the agency of 借助……的力量；through human agency 通过人的作为

例句.英文: Japa Pallikkathayil has advanced one answer by appealing to a duty to respect others’ agential interests: the possession of false beliefs constrains agency, and thus we ought not to impede the formation of true beliefs unless doing so prevents a greater constraint on someone’s agency or an otherwise impermissible end.
例句.中文: 贾帕·帕利卡泰尔提出了一种回答，诉诸「尊重他人能动性利益」的义务：持有虚假信念会限制能动性，因此我们不应阻碍真信念的形成，除非这样做能防止对他人能动性更大的限制，或本身就是不被允许的目的。

例句.英文: But Nixon’s legacy is complex: he has been praised for his role in creating the Environmental Protection Agency, and he once made an attempt at reforming United States health care policy that is arguably a precursor to the Affordable Care Act, which became law during the Barack Obama administration.
例句.中文: 但尼克松的遗产是复杂的：他因在创建美国国家环境保护局（EPA）中扮演的角色而受到赞誉，而他当年对美国医疗政策的一次改革尝试，也可以说是《平价医疗法案》的先声——后者在奥巴马任内成为法律。

义项: 名词 家族血统、祖先链条；可指贵族家系
名词 生物学：maternal evolutionary lineage 母系演化支系
名词 思想、技艺在师承或流派中的传递谱系

例句.英文: Working with a large sample of honey bee specimens collected from most US states, the researchers determined that there are just three maternal evolutionary lineages in the populations: the North Mediterranean lineage, the West Mediterranean lineage, and the African lineage.
例句.原书高亮: maternal evolutionary lineages in the populations:
例句.中文: 研究者对采集自美国大部分州的大量蜜蜂标本进行分析，确定这些种群中只有三个母系演化支系：北地中海支系、西地中海支系和非洲支系。

例句.英文: In Rhythm Lineage, Maya Johnson, René Baptiste, and other dancers seamlessly interweave recent dance styles, including house and waacking, with elements of the Lindy Hop, a popular swing dance of the 1930s with roots in the Black American community of Harlem, New York.
例句.中文: 在《Rhythm Lineage》中，Maya Johnson、René Baptiste 等舞者将浩室舞、甩手舞等当代舞风，与林迪舞的元素无缝交织——林迪舞是 1930 年代流行的摇摆舞，植根于纽约哈莱姆的非裔美国人社区。

义项: 名词 生物学：不同物种独立演化出相似性状（convergent evolution）
名词 观点、趋势、数据逐渐走向一致；与 divergence 相对
名词 数学：数列或级数趋近于某一极限值

例句.英文: Meanwhile, Cynthia C. Steiner and colleagues have investigated how convergence occurs through different genetic mechanisms, but the relative prevalence of convergence through shared and different genetic processes is still poorly understood.
例句.原书高亮: investigated how convergence occurs through different
例句.中文: 与此同时，Cynthia C. Steiner 及其同事研究了趋同现象如何通过不同的遗传机制发生，但经由共享遗传过程与不同遗传过程实现的趋同，其相对普遍程度仍不清楚。

义项: 名词 （旧时）拦路抢劫的骑马强盗
名词 (引申义) 真题中以专有名「Florida Highwaymen」出现，指 1950–60 年代佛罗里达一群自学成才的黑人风景画家；SAT 常考专名的字面义反差

例句.英文: Driven to sell as many paintings as possible, Alfred Hair, an influential figure among the landscape artists known as the Florida Highwaymen, pioneered “fast painting,” a technique (which in part involved slashing in elements with a palette knife) that many Highwaymen, including James Gibson, adopted.
例句.中文: 为了尽可能多卖画，Alfred Hair——被称作「佛罗里达公路客」的风景画家群体中的核心人物——开创了「快画法」，一种用调色刀快速抹出物象的技法，后来被包括 James Gibson 在内的许多同派画家采用。

例句.英文: But there was room for individuation: Sylvester Wells's Fire Sky Palms, for example, may resemble other Highwaymen paintings at first glance, but his works stand out for their occasional depictions of scenes from everyday life.
例句.中文: 但个人风格仍有空间：例如 Sylvester Wells 的《Fire Sky Palms》乍看与其他「公路画家」的作品相似，但他偶尔描绘日常生活场景，使作品脱颖而出。

义项: 动词 manifest as / in 以……形式表现出来；症状、倾向的具体呈现
形容词 显而易见、无需推断的（manifest injustice 显失公平）
名词 船舶或飞机的载货清单；与动词义区分

例句.英文: Yes, the great cloud was ravelling, discovering here and there a pale and dying sky, and the sun, already down, was manifest in the livid tongues of fire darting towards the zenith, falling and darting again, ever more pale and languid, and doomed no sooner lit to be extinguished.
例句.中文: 是的，那大片云彩正在舒卷绽开，这里那里露出一角苍白垂死的天空；已沉落的太阳显形于冲天疾窜的青灰色火舌之中——落了又窜，愈发苍白无力，刚一闪亮便注定熄灭。

例句.英文: Etta-Nkwelle posited that herding would manifest in regional peer countries converging on the same foreign currency accumulation rate regardless of each country’s observable circumstances.
例句.中文: Etta-Nkwelle 提出：「羊群效应」会表现为同一地区的伙伴国家不管各自可观察到的实际处境如何，都趋同于相同的外汇积累速率。

义项: 形容词 （作家、艺术家）作品数量极多的
形容词 (引申义) （生物）繁殖力强的； prolific 与 productive 的区别在于强调「量大且持续」

例句.英文: But not all Highwaymen fully embraced this approach; for instance, though Willie Reagan was also prolific, his paintings were executed with greater attention to detail.
例句.中文: 「佛罗里达公路客」——20 世纪 50 至 60 年代活跃于佛州的一个松散而多产的风景画家群体——的作品，因反复采用同一类构图与题材（如月光下的水面、草丛密布的内陆河流）而极易辨认。

例句.英文: Mexican architect Luis Barragan's prolific career, which spanned the 1920s to the 1980s, evolved through distinct phases.
例句.中文: 墨西哥建筑师路易斯·巴拉干多产的职业生涯横跨 1920 年代至 1980 年代，经历了若干截然不同的阶段。

义项: 名词 差异；不一致；矛盾之处
名词 explain / account for the discrepancy 解释这一差异（真题高频）
搭配说明: discrepant — adj. 有出入的；不一致的（真题：too sparse and discrepant）
discrepancy ≠ discredit — 形近异义：discredit 是「使受怀疑 / 败坏名声」

例句.英文: This discrepancy is explicable in terms of OFT: the monkeys' greater reliance on vision means that higher lunar intensity benefits them more than it benefits the mice.
例句.原书高亮: This discrepancy is explicable in terms of OFT
例句.中文: 这一差异可以用最优觅食理论（OFT）来解释：猴子对视觉的依赖更强，因此月光增强对它们的益处超过对鼠类的益处。

例句.英文: Savoca and colleagues resolve this apparent discrepancy by pointing out that baleen whales cycle iron in the ocean, helping support phytoplankton populations, which, in turn, sustain krill populations.
例句.中文: Savoca 及同事通过指出须鲸在海洋中循环铁元素、帮助维持浮游植物种群——进而支撑磷虾种群——化解了这一明显的矛盾。

义项: 动词 减轻（问题、风险、痛苦）的严重程度，mitigate a problem / risk
[辨析] 不是「消除」：真题里 mitigate these challenges 后仍说 success has been constrained，即只缓和未解决

例句.英文: Ethicist Ingrid Robeyns argues in her work that taxes on the very wealthy should be increased so that governments will be enabled to solve problems of collective action, such as mitigating climate change.
例句.中文: 虽然缓解这些难题的新方案不断涌现——例如使用自动配送机器人——但成效仍受限制，因为会衍生出额外麻烦（如机器人须避让大量地面障碍，行进速度偏慢）。

例句.英文: But they note that this damage can be mitigated: building vapor barriers between structural foundations and the soil can significantly reduce the effects of soil swelling and shrinking.
例句.中文: 但他们指出这种损害是可以缓解的：在地基与土壤之间修建隔汽层，能显著减轻土壤胀缩的影响。

义项: 名词 precursor to 某事物的雏形或早期形态
名词 在事件发生前出现的信号（a precursor of change）
名词 化学 / 生物：参与反应生成目标产物的起始物质

例句.英文: But Nixon's legacy is complex;: he has been praised for his role in opening relations between the United States and China, and he once made an attempt at reforming United States health care policy that is arguably a precursor to the Affordable Care Act, which became law during the Barack Obama administration.
例句.原书高亮: a precursor to the Affordable Care Act
例句.中文: 但尼克松的政治遗产是复杂的：他因推动美中关系正常化而受到赞誉，他还曾尝试改革美国医疗保障政策，那项尝试可以说是《平价医疗法案》的前身，该法案在巴拉克·奥巴马执政期间成为法律。

例句.英文: Paris Opera Ballet dancer Marie Camargo introduced a seemingly simple innovation to the ballet world of the 1730s by removing the heels from her dance shoes, creating the precursor to today’s soft ballet slipper.
例句.中文: 巴黎歌剧院芭蕾舞者 Marie Camargo 给 1730 年代的芭蕾界带来了一项看似简单的革新——去掉舞鞋的鞋跟，由此成为今日软底芭蕾舞鞋的前身。

义项: 名词 小说、戏剧中的中心人物；与 antagonist 相对
名词 a protagonist of reform 改革的积极推动者
名词 争议或运动中的核心人物

例句.英文: Scott Fitzgerald's 1920 novel This Side of Paradise contains elements drawn from Fitzgerald's own life—there are many parallels between the experiences of the novel's protagonist, Amory Blaine, and those of Fitzgerald—and as a result This Side of Paradise is regularly described as an autobiographical novel.
例句.中文: 菲茨杰拉德 1920 年的小说《人间天堂》含有取材于他本人经历的元素——小说主人公艾默里·布莱恩的经历与菲茨杰拉德的经历有许多相似之处，因此《人间天堂》常被描述为一部自传体小说。

义项: 动词 介导；作为…的中介而起传导 / 促成作用（X mediates Y：X 决定或传导 Y）——科研语境核心义
动词 调解；斡旋（mediate between A and B）
动词 构成复合形容词「X-mediated」（由 X 介导的）：microorganism-mediated cycling
搭配说明: mediation / mediator — n. 中介作用 / 中介者（应备派生）
immediate — adj. 同根：im-（无）+ mediate，字面「无中介的」

例句.英文: By persistently modifying the voice, hyperpop invites the listener to reflect on the extent to which digital technology mediates the human experience today.
例句.原书高亮: digital technology mediates the human experience
例句.中文: 通过持续对人声进行改造，hyperpop 引导听者反思：数字技术在多大程度上中介着当今的人类经验。

例句.英文: Subsequent investigation of potential selection mechanisms prompted the researchers to conclude that independent of avian order, the prevalence of the trait is mediated by environmental variations associated with the absolute latitude of brooding sites.
例句.中文: 对潜在选择机制的后续研究促使学者们得出结论：与鸟类目无关，该性状的普遍程度受繁殖地绝对纬度相关的环境差异所调节。

义项: 形容词 sophisticated adj. 精密的；尖端的；老练的（真题唯一形态，29 次）
形容词 科技语境多指「精密的、技术含量高的」；形容人则指「老练的、有品味的」，均非贬义
动词 使复杂化；使变得老练
搭配说明: sophistication — n. 精密（程度）；老练
sophistication ≠ sophistry — 后者是「诡辩」，贬义，形近异义

例句.英文: The British Bronze Age began when sophisticated techniques for making tools, weapons, and other objects from metal were introduced to the British Isles around 2500 BCE, and it lasted until around 700 BCE.
例句.中文: 英国青铜时代始于约公元前 2500 年——当时用金属制造工具、武器及其他器物的精密技术传入不列颠群岛——一直延续到约公元前 700 年。

例句.英文: Studies conducted in individual Western societies have demonstrated associations between personality traits and five musical factors (mellowness, unpretentiousness, sophistication, intensity, and contemporariness) underlying individual preferences for styles of Western music.
例句.中文: 在西方单一社会中进行的研究已证明：人格特质与偏好西方音乐风格的个体差异背后的五个音乐因子（柔和、朴实、精致、强度、当代性）之间存在关联。

义项: 名词 对进口商品征收的税，常与 quota 并考（impose tariffs, eliminate tariffs）
名词 英式用法：旅馆、服务的收费表

例句.英文: In a 2021 report, economist Jayson Beckman modeled global market prices of several agricultural commodities under both the TFA and an alternative trade-reform scenario: removal of agricultural tariffs (taxes on imports that generally increase prices on imported goods).
例句.中文: 经济学家 Jayson Beckman 在 2021 年的一份报告中建模比较了几种农产品的全球市场价格：一种情形是《贸易便利化协定》（TFA），另一种是替代性贸易改革方案——取消农业关税（关税即对进口商品征收的税，通常会抬高进口商品的价格）。

例句.英文: To measure whether countries in free trade agreements (FTAs)—agreements among nations to reduce tariffs, duties, and other trade barriers—experience changes in total agricultural exports, economist Kayode Ajewole and colleagues calculated average export growth rates for several countries over the five years before and the five years after entering an FTA with the United States.
例句.中文: 为衡量签署自由贸易协定（FTA——国家间降低关税及其他贸易壁垒的协定）的国家农产品出口总额是否变化，经济学家 Kayode Ajewole 及同事计算了多个国家与美国签订 FTA 前后各五年的平均出口增长率。

义项: 动词 生物 / 环境语境：某处栖息或含有大量物种、物质（harbors great biodiversity）
动词 持有某种想法或情绪而不表露（harbor doubts, harbor resentment）；SAT 最常考的抽象义
动词 法律语境：为他人或违禁物提供藏身之处
名词 harbor seal 港海豹

例句.英文: With its distinct water chemistry, temperature, and life-forms, the HZ harbors great biodiversity, including microbes that play a key role in regulating trace element removal and other critical ecological processes.
例句.原书高亮: the HZ harbors great biodiversity, including
例句.中文: 凭借独特的水化学、温度和生命形态，该热液区孕育着丰富的生物多样性，包括在调控微量元素去除等关键生态过程中发挥作用的微生物。

例句.英文: In a paper for an art history class, a student claims that Agnes Martin's 1957 painting Harbor Number 1 marks a significant change in Martin's artistic development.
例句.中文: 在一篇艺术史课程论文中，一位学生主张：Agnes Martin 1957 年的画作《港口一号》标志着她艺术发展的重大转变。

义项: 名词 （金属器物、钱币的）窖藏；一批埋藏的珍宝
动词 囤积；贮藏（hoard food / information）
搭配说明: hoard ≠ horde — 同音异义经典陷阱：horde 是「一大群人 / 游牧部落」
a hoard of artifacts — 一批器物窖藏——真题搭配

例句.英文: Collections of metal items (called hoards) from all periods of the Bronze Age have been found in Britain, including the Llanarmon-yn-lal hoard of artifacts from the 16th century BCE, unearthed around 1982, and the much later Horsehope Craig hoard of artifacts from the 7th century BCE, unearthed around 1865.
例句.中文: 在英国已发现各个时期青铜时代的金属器物收藏（称为「窖藏」），包括约 1982 年出土的公元前 16 世纪 Llanarmon-yn-lal 器物窖藏，以及年代晚得多、约 1865 年出土的公元前 7 世纪 Horsehope Craig 器物窖藏。

例句.英文: For hoards discovered since the 1960s, such as the 1965 discovery of the Walderslade hoard, advancements like inexpensive metal detectors, ground penetrating radar, and aerial surveys have made it much easier for searchers to locate hoards before putting the first shovel in the ground.
例句.中文: 对 1960 年代以后发现的窖藏（如 1965 年发现的 Walderslade 窖藏）而言，廉价金属探测器、探地雷达与航空勘测等进步，使寻宝者在动第一铲之前就更容易定位窖藏。

义项: 动词 抑制；阻碍（过程、活动、生长）
动词 使（人）拘谨；使不敢自如表现
搭配说明: inhibition / inhibitor — n. 抑制（作用）/ n. 抑制剂
inhibit ≠ exhibit — 形近异义：exhibit 是「展出、表现出」

例句.英文: Isolates are more prevalent in mountainous regions, likely because challenging terrain inhibits the geographical expansion of language families.
例句.中文: 长久以来，学者们把目光锁定在实验性诗体与传统诗体之争上，这阻碍了人们去探究诗歌之间其他方面的风格对应关系——而那些探究本可以丰富我们对现代主义经典的理解。

例句.英文: All stainless steel contains varying amounts of iron, carbon, and corrosion-inhibiting chromium.
例句.中文: 所有不锈钢都含有不同比例的铁、碳和抗腐蚀的铬。

义项: 名词 某一学科共同体共用的理论框架、方法与范例（methodological paradigms）
名词 (引申义) 典范、样板； paradigm shift 范式转换

例句.英文: Indeed, contrary to the popular myth of the lone genius, theirs is not the first paradigm-shifting theory to have emerged from multiple scholars working in parallel.
例句.中文: 的确，与「孤胆天才」的流俗神话相反，它们并不是第一个由多名学者并行研究而涌现出的范式转移理论。

例句.英文: Note "putatively": as Gavin Kennedy has shown, Smith deploys this metaphor only once in his economic writings—to make a narrow point about the then-dominant economic theory of mercantilism—​​​​​​​and it was largely ignored until some twentieth-century economists eager to secure an intellectual pedigree for their views elevated it to a fully-fledged paradigm.
例句.中文: 注意「所谓」二字：正如 Gavin Kennedy 所证实的，斯密在其经济学著述中仅使用过这一隐喻一次——只为就当时占主导的重商主义理论提出一个狭隘论点——此后它基本无人问津，直到二十世纪一些急于为自己的观点寻找思想谱系的经济学家，才把它抬升为羽翼丰满的范式。

义项: 名词 高于标准价的部分（pay a premium for organic produce）；品牌权益常表现为 price premium
名词 保险语境：投保人按期缴纳的保费；policyholder 即投保人
形容词 作定语表示高端版本（premium version, premium service）
名词 at a premium 稀缺而昂贵；put a premium on 重视

例句.英文: Luis Aguiar studied the effect of the 2011 implementation of a restriction on the free version of the French streaming service Deezer: its unlimited usage was reduced to five hours a month, while the paid premium version’s usage remained unlimited.
例句.原书高亮: the paid premium version’s usage remained
例句.中文: 路易斯·阿吉亚尔研究了 2011 年法国流媒体服务 Deezer 对免费版实施限制的效果：其无限使用时长被削减到每月五小时，而付费高级版的时长则保持不限。

例句.英文: Mariana Lopes Barata and Pedro Simões Coelho collected data from 324 music-streaming service users to identify factors that influence users to opt for paid (premium) versions of music streaming services, like Apple Music.
例句.中文: Mariana Lopes Barata 与 Pedro Simões Coelho 收集了 324 名音乐流媒体服务用户的数据，以识别影响用户选择付费（premium）版本服务的因素。

义项: 动词 阻碍；妨碍（进展、运动、视线）
[构词] im-（在内）+ ped（脚）→ 绊住脚
搭配说明: impediment — n. 障碍；（言语）障碍、口吃
impede ≠ impel — 形近而方向相反：impel 是「推动、促使」

例句.英文: Creeping dogwood (Cornus canadensis) plants are native to Alaska, where harsh conditions have historically impeded potential invasive species.
例句.原书高亮: harsh conditions have historically impeded potential invasive species
例句.中文: 草茱萸（Cornus canadensis）原产于阿拉斯加，那里严酷的环境条件历来阻挡了潜在的入侵物种。

例句.英文: The morphological novelty of echinoderms—marine invertebrates with radial symmetry, usually starlike, around a central point—impedes comparisons with most other animals, in which bilateral symmetry on an anterior-posterior (head to tail) axis through a trunk is typical.
例句.中文: 棘皮动物——具辐射对称（通常呈星形、围绕中心点）的海洋无脊椎动物——的形态学新奇性，妨碍了与多数其他动物的比较；后者典型特征是躯干沿前后（头到尾）轴的两侧对称。

义项: 名词 可量化的可能性（a 99.7% probability that… 有 99.7% 的概率……；the probability of success 成功概率）——SAT 科学 / 统计类篇章高频
[构词] probable（很可能的）+ -ility；反义 improbability
[辨析] probability 可量化（带百分比或 0–1 数值，真题 0.20 / 99.7% 皆如此）；possibility 只问「有没有可能」，不谈大小，真题多作 to test / evaluate this possibility（待检验的假设）。中文都可译「可能性」，但 probability 更近「概率、几率」
搭配说明: possibility — 对照词 · 真题亦现 70+ 次（the possibility that… / to evaluate this possibility）——泛指可能性，不带数值
probabilities — 复数形态 · 真题 1 次（multiple probabilities 多种概率取值）

例句.英文: if you flip a coin 1,000 times, there is a 99.7% probability that the coin will land heads side up between 450 and 550 times.
例句.中文: 抛一枚硬币 1000 次，正面朝上的次数落在 450 到 550 次之间的概率（probability）为 99.7%。

例句.英文: It has been suggested that warming-induced delays in the onset of subfreezing temperatures in autumn can benefit invasives more than native species; to evaluate this possibility, biologists Christa Mulder and Katie Spellman tracked V. edule and P. aviculare, along with other native and invasive species, over several years, concluding that invasives are advantaged by delays in subfreezing temperature onset in Alaska.
例句.中文: 有观点认为，秋季零下温度来临的推迟对入侵物种的益处大于本地物种；为检验这一可能性（possibility），生物学家 Christa Mulder 与 Katie Spellman 连续多年追踪两种植物及其他本地、入侵物种，最终得出结论：在阿拉斯加，入侵物种确实因零下温度的推迟而获益。

义项: 动词 把已有资源当作筹码来达成目的（leverage its brand recognition）
名词 金融语境：以借贷放大收益（financial leverage, high leverage）
名词 谈判或政治语境：可动用的支配力（political leverage）

例句.英文: The Virgin Group's introduction of the Virgin Atlantic airline in 1984 is an instance of brand extension—the company leveraged its brand recognition as a music retailer to enter a product category where it had not previously competed.
例句.原书高亮: extension—the company leveraged its brand recognition
例句.中文: 维珍集团 1984 年推出维珍大西洋航空，是品牌延伸的一例——公司利用其作为音乐零售商的品牌知名度，进入了一个此前并未参与的品类。

例句.英文: In his 2023 collection The Diaspora Sonnets, Filipino American poet Oliver de la Paz leverages the sonnet form’s “diamond-like quality of precision,” as he describes it.
例句.中文: 在 2023 年的诗集《离散十四行诗》中，菲律宾裔美国诗人 Oliver de la Paz 借用了十四行诗体「钻石般的精准质地」（他自己的说法）。

义项: 动词 对税款、罚款或费用强制收取（fines levied against offenders 对违法者课以罚款；a levy on imports 进口税）
动词 拉丁 levare（举升）→ levy 征收 / 动员（levy troops 征兵）；→ lever 杠杆 → leverage 杠杆作用 / 借力利用（leveraged its brand recognition 借品牌认知度）；→ elevate 举升、提升——四词同根，义随词形分化
[辨析] levy 强调「强制收取」；同根 leverage 强调「借力打力」，切勿因形近而混
搭配说明: leveraged — 同根 leverage 的真题形态 · 7 次（the company leveraged its brand recognition——品牌延伸类篇章高频）
leverage — 同根词 · 真题另见 2 次（n./v. 借助、杠杆作用）——按老师规则并入本词条，不单独立条
levied — 本词真题形态 · 1 次（levied against high-profile offenders）

例句.英文: Moreover, enforcement was generally limited to fines, which, when levied against high‑profile offenders, were widely announced.
例句.中文: 此外，执法通常仅限于罚款；而当罚款针对的是高知名度违法者时，往往会被广泛报道。

例句.英文: The Lego Group's introduction of the Legoland theme park in 1968 is a quintessential instance of brand extension—the company leveraged its brand recognition as a toy manufacturer to enter a product category where it had not previously competed.
例句.中文: 乐高集团 1968 年推出乐高乐园主题公园，是品牌延伸的典型范例——公司借助（leveraged）其作为玩具制造商的品牌认知度，进入了此前从未涉足的产品类别。

义项: 名词 经济语境：收入超过支出，或产量超过需求（budget surplus, surplus goods）
形容词 作定语：超出所需（surplus labor, surplus value）

例句.英文: John Iliffe and other Africanist scholars have shown, however, that in parts of Africa, surplus capital accrual, the existence of salaried labor, and other features of capitalism predated colonization.
例句.中文: 然而，克里斯莱恩·阿尔法加利等非洲研究学者已经表明，在非洲部分地区，雇工竞争、为货币化销售而进行的剩余商品生产，以及资本主义的其他特征，都早于殖民时期就已存在。

例句.英文: While people who pursue other art forms—sculpture, film, theater—require large blocks of uninterrupted time as well as money to complete their work, poets can write, as Lorde said, "between shifts, in the hospital pantry, on the subway, and on scraps of surplus paper."So poets can make worthwhile art even if they must earn their living in another way.
例句.中文: 从事其他艺术形式——雕塑、电影、戏剧——的人需要大段不被打断的时间和金钱才能完成作品，而诗人却可以像 Lorde 说的那样「在轮班之间、在医院配餐间、在地铁上、在多余的纸片上」写作。因此，即便诗人必须另谋生计，也能创作出有价值的艺术。

义项: 动词 高度赞扬；推崇（常用被动 be acclaimed / widely acclaimed）
名词 赞誉；喝彩（critical acclaim 评论界的赞誉）
搭配说明: acclaimed — adj. 备受赞誉的——真题唯一形态，15 次
acclamation — n. 欢呼拥戴（一致口头通过）

例句.英文: Her acclaimed 2019 young adult novel Ghost Bird is set in a Murri community in Queensland, Australia.
例句.中文: 她 2019 年广受好评的青少年小说《幽灵鸟》以澳大利亚昆士兰的一个 Murri 社群为背景。

例句.英文: The Marsalis family is often referred to as "the first family of jazz. " Four of the children of celebrated pianist Ellis Marsalis Jr. went on to become performers who are also critically acclaimed: drummer Jason, trombonist Delfeayo, saxophonist Branford, and trumpeter Wynton.
例句.中文: Marsalis 一家常被称为「爵士乐第一家庭」：著名钢琴家 Ellis Marsalis Jr. 的四个孩子后来都成为广受好评的演奏家——鼓手 Jason、长号手 Delfeayo、萨克斯手 Branford 和小号手 Wynton。

义项: 形容词 类似的；可类比的（analogous to / with X）
形容词 同功的——功能相似但起源不同，与 homologous「同源的」相对
搭配说明: analogy — n. 类比；by analogy with 依…类推
analogue — n. 类似物；adj. 模拟的（与 digital 相对）

例句.英文: Probabilistic models generate predictions based on outcomes of analogous past events, but even as these models project likely outcomes, they implicitly acknowledge that lower-frequency events may occur instead.
例句.中文: 历史学家与传记作者所传达的那种知识，类似于我们借地图获得的对一个国家的认识——也许细致、准确，足以应付一切实际需要，但冰冷而干瘪，全然没有风景画所营造的那种摹仿性的魅力。

例句.英文: Weitz assessed these trade-offs by comparing vascular function in the reticulate patterns of Alchornea ilicifolia (native holly) and other angiosperm leaf veins with that of analogous open-branching patterns.
例句.中文: Weitz 通过比较 Alchornea ilicifolia（冬青）等被子植物叶片网状脉序与类似的开放分支脉序的维管功能，来评估这些利弊权衡。

义项: 名词 锻打金属用的砧台；亦指耳内听小骨之一（砧骨）
名词 (引申义) 诗中 the lack of anvil and strife 以「无砧（无劳作、无争斗）」写心境之宁静，SAT 文学题常考具体名词的抽象转喻

例句.英文: We trekked into a far country,My friend and I. Our deeper content was never spoken,But each knew all the other said. He told me how calm his soul was laidBy the lack of anvil and strife. “The wooing kestrel,” I said, “mutes his mating-noteTo please the harmony of this sweet silence.”
例句.中文: 我们跋涉进入一片遥远的乡野，我与我的友人。我们更深的心事从未说出口，但彼此都懂对方未言之意。他告诉我，因无砧无争，他的灵魂是何等安宁静穆。

例句.英文: By using fixed stones as anvils, tool-using otters gained access to high-quality, hard-shelled prey (e.g., mussels and clams) that they could usually not access through biting alone.
例句.中文: 借助固定石块作砧，会使用工具的水獭得以获取通常无法单靠撕咬打开的优质硬壳猎物（如贻贝和蛤蜊）。

义项: 形容词 与档案、文献收藏有关的（archival information / records）
[构词] archive n. 档案 → archival adj.；注意与 archaeological（考古的）区分

例句.英文: In her exhibition Strike Gulf, she interrogated the impact of the oil and gas industry on southern Louisiana (where she grew up), incorporating core samples from deep seabeds off the Louisiana coast, oil well data, archival information about oil boycotts, and video she took in New Orleans.
例句.原书高亮: well data, archival information about oil
例句.中文: 在《Strike Gulf》展览中，她审视油气产业对南路易斯安那（她长大的地方）的影响，作品纳入了路易斯安那近海深部海床的岩芯样本、油井数据、关于石油抵制运动的档案资料，以及她在新奥尔良拍摄的影像。

例句.英文: One reason for this discrepancy is that historians of capitalism tend to focus on longitudinal economic data drawn from archival records, which do not exist for much of precolonial Africa.
例句.中文: 造成这种差异的一个原因是：资本主义史学家倾向于关注取自档案记录的纵向经济数据，而前殖民时代的非洲大部分地区并不存在这类记录。

义项: 名词 某一领域中被反复使用、带有预设的言说方式（paleontological discourse, public discourse）
名词 语言学语境：大于句子的连贯语言单位（discourse analysis）
动词 正式地论述（discourse on the nature of beauty）

例句.英文: A debate in paleontological discourse focuses on whether ancient pandas first emerged in Asia before migrating to Europe, or vice versa.
例句.原书高亮: in paleontological discourse focuses on whether
例句.中文: 古生物学界的一场争论聚焦于：古代熊猫究竟是先出现在亚洲再迁往欧洲，还是相反。

义项: 名词 离群索居、独处修行的人
名词 (引申义) 真题以 stripe-throated hermits 出现，指「隐蜂鸟」类 hummingbird；专名中的普通词常是 SAT 词义题考点

例句.英文: High-reward flowers that produce nectar with relatively high sugar concentrations are thought to be especially attractive to stripe-throated hermits and other hummingbird species.
例句.原书高亮: to stripe-throated hermits and other hummingbird
例句.中文: 糖分浓度较高的高回报花蜜型花朵，被认为对条纹喉隐蜂鸟及其他蜂鸟种类尤其具有吸引力。

例句.英文: Biologists Louise Roberts and Mark Laidre noticed that hermit crabs sometimes vibrate their shells and wondered if they do this to scare away other crabs.
例句.中文: 生物学家 Louise Roberts 和 Mark Laidre 注意到寄居蟹有时会震动自己的壳，并猜想它们这样做是为了吓退其他螃蟹。

义项: 名词 微生物（显微镜下才可见的生物体）
[构词] micro-（微小）+ organism（生物体）
搭配说明: microbe — n. 微生物——同义，真题另现 10 次
microorganism-mediated — adj. 微生物介导的——真题复合形容词

例句.英文: Microorganism-mediated nutrient cycling was accelerated in the transplanted cores; crucially, microorganism community composition was unchanged, allowing Kastovska et al. to attribute the acceleration to temperature-induced increases in microorganism activity.
例句.中文: 在被移植的土芯中，由微生物介导的养分循环被加快了；关键在于微生物群落构成并未改变，这使得 Kastovska 等人得以把这种加快归因于温度上升带来的微生物活性提高。

例句.英文: Just like household dust on Earth, dust on the International Space Station (ISS) harbors hundreds of common microorganisms—Aspergillus hongkongensis and other fungi, along with bacteria, such as Staphylococcus pettenkoferi.
例句.中文: 正如地球上的家居灰尘一样，国际空间站（ISS）上的灰尘也藏有数百种常见微生物——包括 Aspergillus hongkongensis 等真菌，以及 Staphylococcus pettenkoferi 等细菌。

义项: 形容词 （艺术、建筑）现代主义风格的；主张功能优先、拒绝传统装饰
名词 modernist n. 现代主义者；与 functionalist 并置时强调「形式服从功能」

例句.英文: As can be seen in the case of Others, a New York magazine published from July 1915 to July 1919, some small periodicals influential in the development of the modernist movement have been explored in depth by scholars.
例句.中文: 正如《Others》一例所见——这本纽约杂志从 1915 年 7 月出版至 1919 年 7 月——一些对现代主义运动的发展颇有影响的小型期刊，已得到学者们的深入探究。

例句.英文: King were among the 300 artists who exhibited at the 1913 Armory Show, a groundbreaking New York City art exhibition that introduced modernism to American audiences.
例句.中文: King 等人均属于 1913 年军械库展的 300 位参展艺术家——这场开创性的纽约艺术展把现代主义介绍给了美国观众。

义项: 名词 （问卷、调查的）应答者；受访者
名词 （上诉案件的）被上诉人
搭配说明: respond / response — v. 回答 / n. 回应
respondent ≠ correspondent — 形近异义：correspondent 是「通讯员、记者」

例句.英文: It may be tempting to assume the difference is due to different levels of access to parks; however, given that the percentage of Caracas respondents who reported living within a 10-minute walk of a park was much lower than that reported by Fortaleza respondents, greater proximity alone can’t explain the difference in park use.
例句.原书高亮: Caracas respondents who reported living within a 10-minute walk
例句.中文: 人们很容易假定这一差异源于接触公园的机会不同；然而，鉴于加拉加斯报告「住在距公园步行 10 分钟范围内」的受访者比例远低于福塔莱萨的受访者，单靠「距离更近」是解释不通的。

例句.英文: The statements are categorized as relevant to one of six topics—e.g., statement 37, "I like when packages delivered to me are tightly packed," is categorized as relevant to the topic of visual appeal—and respondents rate the importance of each statement to their experience.
例句.中文: 这些陈述被归入六个主题之一——例如第 37 条「我喜欢送到我手中的包裹被塞得紧紧实实」被归入「视觉吸引力」主题——受访者对每条陈述对其体验的重要程度打分。

义项: 名词 政策与商业语境：受某项决定影响的个人或群体（stakeholders in urban agriculture）
名词 金融语境：持有公司股份者；与 shareholder 常可互换

例句.英文: Esther Sanye-Mengual, Kathrin Specht, and their team surveyed three groups of people in Bologna, Italy— leaders of urban agriculture projects, stakeholders in urban agriculture (e.g., food researchers and urban farming associations), and the general public—to compare their views about the extent to which urban agriculture contributes to 25 social or ecological services that the team identified.
例句.原书高亮: agriculture projects, stakeholders in urban agriculture
例句.中文: 埃丝特·桑耶-门瓜尔、卡特琳·施佩希特及其团队调查了意大利博洛尼亚的三类人群——城市农业项目的负责人、城市农业的利益相关方（如食品研究者和城市农艺协会）以及普通公众——以比较他们对城市农业在多大程度上促成各项社会或生态服务的看法。

例句.英文: Using only the rankings shown in the table, a city planner in Bologna who is promoting a new urban agriculture project concludes that advertisements aimed at stakeholders should emphasize the project's benefit to the enhancement of pollination.
例句.中文: 仅凭表中所示的排名，博洛尼亚一位正在推广新城市农业项目的城市规划者得出结论：面向利益相关方的宣传应强调该项目对促进授粉的益处。

义项: 形容词 方案、商业模式在现实中能运转（a viable alternative）
形容词 生物学：种子能发芽、胚胎能发育（viable seeds）
形容词 经济 / 生态：能自我维持、不依赖外部输血

例句.英文: The technology, while generating lots of interest, is not yet commercially viable as a large-scale energy source.
例句.中文: 这项技术虽然备受关注，但作为大规模能源尚不具备商业可行性。

例句.英文: In 2022, Guillermo Restrepo calculated the historical rates at which newly discovered compounds have entered the scientific literature, expanding the “chemical space.” Using a conservative estimate of the number of viable compounds and assuming a doubling of the historical pace of discovery, Restrepo found that under these hypothetical conditions, all potential compounds could be synthesized and documented by 2050.
例句.中文: 2022 年，Guillermo Restrepo 计算了新发现的化合物进入科学文献、从而拓展「化学空间」的历史速率。采用对可行化合物数量的保守估计，并假设发现速度翻倍，Restrepo 发现在这些假设条件下，所有潜在化合物都可在 2050 年前被合成并记录。

义项: 名词 （常用复数）生活便利设施；福利设施（neighborhood amenities）
名词 舒适；宜人（the amenity of a place）
搭配说明: amenities — n.（复数）便利设施——真题 18 次全为复数
amenity ≠ amnesty — 形近异义：amnesty 是「大赦」

例句.英文: This approach has some limits—data from Places API tend to be restricted to places that are customer facing—but the data set nonetheless provides an extremely reliable source to study colocation patterns of neighborhood amenities.
例句.中文: 这一方法有某些局限——来自 Places API 的数据往往只覆盖面向顾客的场所——但该数据集仍不失为研究社区便利设施空间共置模式的极其可靠的来源。

例句.英文: Vancouver has high pedestrian traffic, but other cities cannot increase their pedestrian traffic simply by replicating a single feature of Vancouver—e.g., its high number of pedestrian amenities—that is associated with walkability.
例句.中文: 温哥华行人流量很高，但其他城市无法仅靠复制温哥华的单一特征（如与步行友好性相关的密集步行设施）来提高自己的行人流量。

义项: 名词 作者身份；（作品的）作者归属
名词 写作（活动）；著述
搭配说明: author — n. 作者 / v. 创作（真题也作动词：a study authored by…）
authorial — adj. 作者的（authorial intent 作者意图）

例句.英文: Though the authorship of most of the individual essays is certain, that of a few is in question: for instance, while No. 37, "Concerning the Difficulties of the Convention in Devising a Proper Form of Government," was surely penned by Madison, No. 62, "The Senate," may have been written by either Hamilton or Madison.
例句.原书高亮: the authorship of most of the individual essays is certain
例句.中文: 尽管大多数单篇文章的作者归属是确定的，仍有几篇存疑：例如，虽然第 37 篇《关于制宪会议设计恰当政府形式之困难》无疑出自麦迪逊之手，第 62 篇《参议院》则可能由汉密尔顿或麦迪逊所写。

例句.英文: In a 1963 rebuttal, film critic Pauline Kael argued that film authorship should be shared among screenwriters, directors, and others involved in the filmmaking process..
例句.中文: 在 1963 年的一篇反驳文章中，影评人 Pauline Kael 主张：电影的作者身份应由编剧、导演及其他参与制片过程的人共享。

义项: 名词 法律与监管语境：遵守规定、标准或法律（regulatory compliance testing）
名词 心理与行为语境：按他人要求行事；与 conformity 近义，但更强调对规则的服从

例句.英文: While bioaccumulation of manufactured nanoparticles may be inherently worrisome, it has been hypothesized that CeO2-NP bioaccumulation in invertebrates like D. polymorpha could serve as a valuable proxy, obviating the need for manufacturers to conduct costly and intrusive sampling of vertebrate species such as rainbow trout (Oncorhynchus mykiss), commonly used in regulatory compliance testing for manipulative bioaccumulation, as environmental protection laws currently require.
例句.中文: 虽然人造纳米颗粒的生物累积本身可能令人担忧，但有人假设，这类纳米颗粒在无脊椎动物体内的累积可以作为有价值的替代指标，使制造商无需再对虹鳟等脊椎动物进行昂贵而具侵入性的取样——这类取样常用于法规合规性检测中的操控性生物累积评估，因为环保法目前有此要求。

例句.英文: … commonly used in regulatory compliance testing—for nanoparticle bioaccumulation, as environmental protection laws currently require.
例句.中文: ……常用于监管合规测试——用于纳米颗粒生物累积检测，正如现行环保法律所要求的那样。

义项: 形容词 彼此分离、各自独立的（discrete units / texts）
[辨析] 与 discreet（谨慎的）同音异义、极易混淆；也区别于 concrete（具体的）

例句.英文: But other critics argue that the books should not be thought of as discrete texts with traditional beginnings and endings but as a single incredibly long work, similar to other multivolume stories, such as Anthony Powell's A Dance to the Music of Time.
例句.原书高亮: of as discrete texts with traditional
例句.中文: 但另一些批评者主张，这些书不应被视为有传统开头与结尾的独立文本，而应看作一部极其漫长的整体作品，类似《随之起舞》这类多卷本小说。

义项: 名词 散布；传播；分散（种子、个体、种群）
名词 seed dispersal 种子传播——真题核心搭配
搭配说明: disperse — v. 散布；消散（真题另现）
dispersion — n. 分散；离差（真题另现 6 次）

例句.英文: Scientists have proposed several possible explanations: fewer species of soil fungi available at the northern edges of the trees’ habitat, physical barriers blocking seed dispersal, or deer overgrazing preventing new trees from establishing.
例句.中文: 科学家提出了几种可能的解释：树木栖息地北缘可利用的土壤真菌种类较少、物理屏障阻断了种子传播，或是鹿的过度啃食使新树无法成活。

例句.英文: Fortes-Lima and colleagues hypothesized that the Bantu expansion—the dispersal starting 4,000–5,000 ya of Bantu-speaking peoples (BSP) from an ancestral homeland in West-Central Africa across sub-Saharan Africa—followed the same pattern.
例句.中文: Fortes-Lima 及同事假设：班图扩张——约四五千年前，讲班图语的民族从中西非的祖居地扩散至撒哈拉以南非洲——也遵循同样的模式。

义项: 形容词 可解释的；可说明的（able to be accounted for）
形容词 explicable in terms of X「可从 X 的角度加以解释」——真题 100% 落在这一个句型上
搭配说明: inexplicable — adj. 无法解释的——反义派生，GRE / SAT 常考
explicable ≠ explicit — 形近异义：explicit 是「明确的」

例句.英文: Joel Brown and colleagues showed that high moonlight intensity inhibits the activity of the Arizona pocket mouse (Perognathus amplus), a result explicable in terms of benefits and costs: greater lunar intensity may not enable the mice to increase foraging success enough to offset the higher chance of detection by predatory owls or hawks.
例句.中文: Joel Brown 及同事表明，月光强度高会抑制亚利桑那囊鼠（Perognathus amplus）的活动，这一结果可从收益与成本的角度解释：更强的月光未必能让囊鼠把觅食成功率提高到足以抵消被捕食性猫头鹰或鹰隼发现的更高风险。

义项: 形容词 纵向的；跨时段的（对同一对象长期追踪，longitudinal study / data）
形容词 经度的（与 latitudinal「纬度的」相对）
搭配说明: longitude — n. 经度
longitudinal ≠ cross-sectional — 纵向研究 vs 横断面研究——社科阅读常见对照

例句.英文: But it is much more expensive to conduct a longitudinal study like the Household, Income and Labour Dynamics in Australia Survey (HILDA), which looks at data for 25,000 people in Australia to find trends in economic well-being that can take a long time to develop.
例句.中文: 但开展像澳大利亚「家庭、收入与劳动力动态」调查（HILDA）这样的纵向研究要昂贵得多——该调查追踪澳大利亚 25,000 人的数据，用以发现需要很长时间才能显现的经济福祉趋势。

例句.英文: As with most longitudinal studies, extensive funding support is needed for SAGE to collect the relevant data over timescales and at intervals that will support robust conclusions.
例句.中文: 与多数纵向研究一样，SAGE 需要大量的经费支持，才能在足以支撑可靠结论的时间尺度和时间间隔上收集相关数据。

义项: 名词 软体动物（螺、贝、章鱼等）
[构词] moll-（软的）+ -usc
搭配说明: molluscan — adj. 软体动物的
crustacean / arthropod — n. 甲壳类 / n. 节肢动物——真题并列类群词
ammonite — n. 菊石——真题与 mollusk 同现

例句.英文: With a shell that measured 1.7 meters, the extinct mollusk Parapuzosia seppenradensis is the largest ammonite in the fossil record.
例句.中文: 壳长达1.7米的已灭绝软体动物 Parapuzosia seppenradensis，是化石记录中最大的菊石。

例句.英文: Over time, marine mollusks called nautilids continually add segments to their shells, and the chemical composition of each segment is influenced by the available materials in the surrounding water when the segment forms.
例句.中文: 随着时间的推移，被称为鹦鹉螺类的海洋软体动物会不断向壳体添加新环节，而每一环节的化学组成都受该环节形成时周围水中可用物质的影响。

义项: 名词 细微差别；微妙之处（意义、情感、色彩上的）
动词 使有细微差别；细致地处理
搭配说明: nuanced — adj. 有细微差别的；精细入微的——真题 4 次
nuance ≠ nuisance — 形近异义：nuisance 是「讨厌的人 / 麻烦事」

例句.英文: The popularity of ningyo joruri was due to a puppetry method called sannin zukai, in which three puppeteers operated a single puppet that was large, detailed, and capable of extensive movement and nuanced emotional expression.
例句.原书高亮: capable of extensive movement and nuanced emotional expression
例句.中文: 人偶净琉璃（ningyo joruri）之所以受欢迎，得益于一种名为「三人遣」（sannin zukai）的木偶操纵法：三名操纵者共同操控一个体积大、做工细的木偶，使其能做出大幅动作与细腻的情感表达。

例句.英文: Moving beyond a simple “present or absent” designation, researchers created a new classification system that allows for a nuanced understanding of bioluminescence in marine organisms that was unavailable under binary classification systems.
例句.中文: 研究者超越了简单的「有 / 无」二分，建立了一套新的分类系统，从而对海洋生物的生物发光形成二元分类体系下不可能有的细腻理解。

义项: 形容词 提供推力、驱动向前的（propulsive beats 指节奏强劲、推着听者往前走）
[构词] propel v. 推进 → propulsive adj.；写作中可引申为「叙事推进感强」

例句.英文: Many artists associated with hyperpop, a movement in electronic music that emerged in the 2010s, conform to the model perfected by American musician Laura Les: bold synthesizer arrangements, propulsive beats, and electronically manipulated vocals.
例句.原书高亮: synthesizer arrangements, propulsive beats, and electronically
例句.中文: 与 2010 年代兴起的电子乐流派 hyperpop 相关的许多音乐人，都遵循美国音乐人 Laura Les 打磨成熟的范式：大胆的合成器编排、极具推进感的节拍，以及经电子处理的人声。

例句.英文: Their combination of lush synthesizer arrangements and propulsive beats with vocals electronically shifted in pitch below their natural range exemplifies the hyperpop sound.
例句.中文: 他们把繁复的合成器编曲与强劲的节拍，与人声经电子变调至低于自然音域的处理相结合，正是超流行音乐的典型声效。

义项: 形容词 基于猜想而非确证（speculative counterfactuals, a speculative answer）
形容词 金融语境：为赚取价差而承担高风险（speculative investment）
形容词 文学类型术语：speculative fiction 推想小说，涵盖科幻、奇幻等

例句.英文: In his introduction, Shurin defines cyberpunk as a subgenre of speculative fiction concerning “the influence of technology on the scale, the pace, or the pattern of human affairs”; however, some critics assert that Shurin’s definition is too broad to distinguish cyberpunk from science fiction more generally.
例句.中文: 舒林在导言中把赛博朋克界定为推想小说的一个亚类型，关注技术对人类事务的规模、节奏或模式的影响；然而一些批评者认为，舒林的定义过于宽泛，无法把赛博朋克与更广义的科幻小说区分开来。

例句.英文: Speculative counterfactuals like these can be great fodder for stories, but they’re also commonly deployed by academic historians to better understand factors influencing historical events.
例句.中文: 这类思辨性的反事实设想可以成为绝好的故事素材，但学院派历史学家也常用它们来更好地理解影响历史事件的因素。

义项: 形容词 化学语境：常温下易蒸发（volatile metal mercury, volatile compounds）
形容词 金融 / 市场语境：价格或行情剧烈起伏；名词 volatility 波动率
形容词 形容情绪或局势（a volatile temperament, a volatile situation）
搭配说明: volatility — 同词根构词变体，真题出现 3 次；已并入本词条

例句.英文: Corrine Walsh and colleagues hypothesized that microbial communities could also affect plants’ flavor chemistry, including volatiles and secondary metabolites like glucosinolates.
例句.中文: 当亚库舍夫、伦斯等人研究 Fl 与金表面的相互作用时，他们发现 Fl 的反应活性低于易挥发的金属汞，但高于惰性气体氡。

义项: 动词 装饰；装点（be adorned with：装饰着…）
动词 (引申义) 使生色；为…增添光彩
搭配说明: adornment — n. 装饰（品）
unadorned — adj. 未经装饰的——真题反义形式
adorn ≠ adore — 形近异义：后者是「崇拜、喜爱」

例句.英文: In his Histories (circa 425 BCE), Herodotus writes of 3,000 chambers adorned with carved figures, a dozen courts flanked by white stone pillars, and many winding passages in the complex, characterizing it as a great labyrinth and “an unending marvel.”
例句.中文: 希罗多德在《历史》（约公元前425年）中写道，这座建筑群有3000间装饰着雕刻人像的厅室、十几个两侧立有白色石柱的庭院，以及许多曲折的通道，他将其形容为一座大迷宫、一处无穷的奇观。

例句.英文: The project's unadorned geometric forms, typical of the modernist aesthetic, contrasted with the historically inspired architecture seen in his earlier projects in Guadalajara, such as the Cristo House.
例句.中文: 该项目不加修饰的几何形式是现代主义美学的典型，与他早年在瓜达拉哈拉的历史风格建筑（如 Cristo 住宅）形成对比。

义项: 形容词 （手法、应对）机敏灵巧、老练的（an adroit blend / an adroit negotiator）
[构词] adroitly adv. 已并入本词条统一计数；反义 maladroit（笨拙的）

例句.英文: In his afterword to Crowley’s book Little, Big, Bloom praises how the novel adroitly blends what playwright Friedrich Schiller termed the naive and sentimental modes—while Schiller thought works could be classified as either naive (seeking to describe reality) or sentimental (seeking to develop ideas), Little, Big fuses both modes of writing.
例句.中文: 在克劳利《小，大》的跋里，布鲁姆盛赞这部小说把席勒所谓「素朴」与「感伤」两种模式娴熟地融为一体——席勒认为作品只能归入其一，而《小，大》证明二者可以兼得。

例句.英文: In his afterword to Crowley's book Little, Big, Bloom argues that the novel adroitly blends what playwright Friedrich Schiller termed the naive and sentimental modes—while Schiller thought works could be classified as either naive (seeking to describe reality) or sentimental (seeking to develop ideas), Little, Big fuses both modes of writing.
例句.中文: 在为 Crowley 的小说《Little, Big》所作的跋中，Bloom 论证这部小说巧妙地融合了剧作家席勒所称的「素朴」与「感伤」两种模式——席勒认为作品非素朴（力求描摹现实）即感伤（力求阐发观念），而《Little, Big》将两种写作模式熔于一炉。

义项: 名词 因果关系；因果性（linear causality 线性因果）
[辨析] causality ≠ correlation（相关性）——SAT 科学类文章核心对立
搭配说明: causal / causally — adj. 因果的 / adv. 因果地——真题另现
cause — n. 原因

例句.英文: Yuen Yuen Ang has recently argued that both positions presume linear causality in situations in which neither phenomenon is truly independent of the other.
例句.中文: 洪源远（Yuen Yuen Ang）最近指出，两种立场都预设了线性因果关系，而在这些情形中，两种现象其实都不真正独立于彼此。

例句.英文: To carry out the necessary sampling of the population over many years, CLSA-ÉLCV needs extensive financial support, but this method provides valuable insights into causal relationships.
例句.中文: 要在多年间对人群进行必要的抽样，CLSA-ÉLCV 需要大量经费支持，但这一方法能为因果关系提供宝贵的洞见。
